name: Ano Aoi Umi Yori
source:
"I thought everything would remain the same...."
Sora has just moved to a town in the country. There is nothing special, but comfortable.... One night, he meets a girl on the beach. He soon feels attracted to her arrogant behavior and mysterious atmosphere. On the next day, he meets her again at school. She says,
"I'll become your friend...."
Sora has mixed feelings, but feels something warm inside his heart. They gradually cultivate their relationship involving other unique residents. Just when they feel happiness, the world is about to change again. When they meet, their crooked and complicating fates cross.... What will happen to them in the end...?
"My one and only wish is not to forget you...." 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
“我原以为，一切都会永远保持原样…”
空刚刚搬到一座乡间小镇。这里没有什么特别之处，却让人感觉十分舒适…一天夜里，他在海滩上遇见一名少女，很快便被她傲慢的举止与神秘的气质所吸引。第二天，他又在学校见到了她。少女说道：
“我要成为你的朋友…”
空心情复杂，内心却感到一阵温暖。在其他个性十足的居民参与之下，两人逐渐培养起感情。然而就在他们感受到幸福时，世界即将再次发生改变。两人相遇之际，各自曲折而复杂的命运也交汇到了一起…最终等待他们的究竟是什么？
“我唯一的愿望，就是不要忘记你…”

[摘自ErogeShop]
